Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: At this step, WebSurfer surfaced an incorrect Wikipedia snippet indicating John Schlesinger’s birth year as 1963 (instead of the correct 1926) without flagging or correcting it. Relying on that erroneous data would invert the comparison and lead to the wrong conclusion that the director of “I Come with the Rain” was born earlier, instead of correctly identifying “A Question of Attribution.”
